title: UT: Facing Demons
text: Fan game 2019–2021 1–1.5 hours Face off against Chara Dreemurr during the genocide route in the StoryShift AU, complete with original twists by our team. Full Russian voice acting. Five unique endings. Three gameplay phases. New Game+. Achievements.

title: Your Own Fear
text: Visual novel 2020 30–40 minutes At a friend’s country house, a second-year engineering student hears an urban legend about a girl murdered at an abandoned factory. On the way home from a party that night, his old Lada stalls on a forest road. While he waits for his friend to pick him up, he notices a light deep in the woods. A skeptic, he sets off to find it, hoping someone lives nearby. Three endings. Exchange messages with other characters. 3 CGs, 11 backgrounds, 6 sprites and 4 music tracks. No English translation

title: UT: StoryShift Asriel Fight
text: Fan game 2022 30–40 minutes Your journey through Snowdin has come to an end. One obstacle remains. That adorable fluffy monster won’t hurt you, but you must help it finish the game. Give it what it asks for! Made in two months. A short, intense battle. A secret ending for a no-damage run.

title: Imprint On The Pages
text: Visual novel 2022 30–40 minutes The pages of a crumpled diary tell the story of a peasant’s son and his dear sister, who endured the horrors of war. For some, their tale is a lesson. For others, it is a reminder of the cruelty of fate. Let us begin with the first page… The story of a traitor to his homeland during World War II. A grotesque visual style. 22nd place at Anivisual Jam 4 (2022) No English translation

title: UT: Flowey’s Inside Out
text: Fan game 2024 20–30 minutes Fight the battle against Omega Flowey from Flowey’s own perspective. The awakened Souls of the fallen children will deliver their verdict upon this lost lamb. Full Russian voice acting. Experience the battle from Flowey’s side. All seven Soul modes. 3rd place at Gamejam for Underparty (Moscow, 2024) Remake in development No English translation

title: UT: Withered Flower
text: Fan game 2025 30–40 minutes Long ago, monsters lost the war and retreated into the caves of Mt. Ebott. Now another soul has fallen into their domain. They will face enemies, meet friends and fight for their freedom, or show how mercy changes the world. That was the plan. Always was. Now you stand before Generalissimo Papyrus, at the beginning of a story whose ending even I do not know. The first chapter of an ongoing game. A full battle with Papyrus at the end of the Ruins. Special combat moves. Illustrated dialogue sprites. To be continued

title: PRISM: Your contract will be ███
text: Visual novel 2026 40–60 minutes Welcome aboard the ███ ship Zrimiy (The Visible). Your identification number is ███. Status confirmed. Before the tour, calibrate your PRISM device for navigation. While it is active, your senses may be restricted to prevent ███, as stipulated in your contract. In the event of a breach, your contract will be ███. We look forward to ███ cooperation, Senior ███ Officer Nikolaev! An hour-long story about censorship, space and loneliness. Use the PRISM device in your eye to scan highlighted areas of interest. Illustrations by an artist with an academic background. 17th place at Kapella Jam 3 (2026) Remake in development No English translation

title: UT: Twists & Turns
text: Fan game 2026 30–40 minutes Play as Mattew, a human who has fallen into an Underground filled with monsters. Find a way out and remember how you got there. Why does it feel like you were never supposed to be the hero of this story? The opening of a story whose ending is yours to decide. Solve puzzles, chat with locals and travel between locations in a point-and-click adventure. Explore Mattew’s inner world in place of a game menu. It reflects your journey and changes as the story progresses. Everyone has something to tell you about this world. Uncover the secrets it holds. To be continued

title: Luck Cursed
text: Visual novel TBA TBA After failing to pull your favorite heroine in a gacha game, you curse God in frustration. To teach you a lesson, God gives you a magical die and sends you to a world bound by a divine Scenario. Will you learn your lesson, or perish in a world where luck does not exist? Roll a six-sided die for every choice. Higher rolls mean better outcomes, but fate can still surprise you. The story unfolds through comic panels. Explore the Test Stage, God’s draft world, where bio-robots imitate humans among grotesque collages. The janitor bio-robot looks suspiciously like your favorite gacha heroine. In development
